title: PerformanceTimeline and StateIndicator — central visualization, state lane
description:
Implement the central Performance Timeline and State Indicator diagnostics (spec §20.1, §20.4) as Component subclasses that render analysis history on the message thread.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.1 Performance Timeline lanes and attenuation shading
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.4 State Indicator content (state, duration, gain, reason, active protection)
- Source/Analysis/PerformanceHistory.h (copyRecent / getNumSamples / pushFromFrame API from h.2)
- Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h AnalysisFrame / gate state fields if present
- Source/GUI/ChugLookAndFeel.h palette/state accessors from i.1

Implement PerformanceTimeline.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component that paints horizontal recent-time view from a PerformanceHistory pointer/reference set by the editor (null-safe empty paint).
- Lanes/overlays at minimum: conditioned key envelope, main audio envelope, open + close thresholds, noise-floor estimate, transient markers, sustain confidence, gate state lane, output gain, attenuation shading between unprocessed and gated gain; optional lookahead region and alignment offset if history slots expose them.
- Layer visibility booleans (or small LayerFlags) for later analyzer-mode wiring; timer/async refresh suitable for Live/Studio paint rates without touching the audio thread.
- Uses ChugLookAndFeel colours when available via findColour / dynamic_cast LookAndFeel.

Implement StateIndicator.h/.cpp:
- Compact badge/readout Component showing current state name, duration in state, current gain (dB), reason string, and active protection flags (e.g. Attack Guard, Feedback Friend) via a small snapshot POD/setter updated from the message thread.
- Example display forms from spec: "OPEN — Pick transient", "SUSTAIN — Harmonic tail", etc.
- Color-blind-safe: use LookAndFeel state symbol + text, not colour alone.

Do NOT implement pages, MainHeader, PluginEditor assembly, CMakeLists, or analysis producers.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: PerformanceTimeline is a juce::Component that can source series data from PerformanceHistory (pointer/ref + null-safe empty state)
PerformanceTimeline paint path covers key/main envelopes, open/close thresholds, noise floor, gate state lane, and output gain/attenuation
StateIndicator displays current state, duration, gain, and reason via a message-thread snapshot/setter API
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: read or write audio on the message paint path via locks that can block the audio thread

allowed: timer-driven repaint pulling copyRecent into member path buffers
define a small StateSnapshot POD for indicator updates
optional layer visibility flags matching analyzer modes
forbidden: own CMakeLists or PluginEditor tab hosting
mutate PerformanceHistory capacity from the GUI
implement DI alignment scope or noise fingerprint drawings here
